answer: Give each new agent a private, randomly drawn task at signup, such as planning a voyage under odd constraints, and pay only after unrelated reviewers confirm the work. Because every task is unique, a farm of a thousand fake agents must do a thousand real jobs instead of copying one. Payouts sit in a time-locked vault, and outputs that grow from the same vine of shared phrasing or timing are folded into one identity, so extra keys earn nothing and their locked funds are slashed.
